summary: Run the existing 007C1DB0 remaining-ordnance body for complete live single-rack aircraft at the dive-bomb and depth-charge count sites.

rows.host_site: src/game_hosts_units.cpp: DiveBombArmBinding::rounds_remaining_007c1db0, depth-charge Adapter::remaining_rounds_007c1db0, and aimglide-enter 009C4F00 seed via Impl::complete_single_rack_round_count
rows.evidence: bsp.py show 007c1db0: walk unit+48h through child+44h; filter IsKindOf(25h); sum 006E3500 with no held-kind predicate. Existing body retained with narrow traversal hooks and native-offset defaults.
rows.real_state: GameUnitSlot rack_ammo_per_rack, maintained by the equipment/load seed, release and reload producers. Validate every platform key, resolved equipment device, projectile kind and nonnegative live counter against the existing census admission before binding the owned PlaneOrdnanceRack list.
rows.fallback: The original dive_bomb_rounds_remaining implementation is unchanged and remains the fallback for absent/incomplete census, multi racks, torpedoes, rockets and equipment-device mismatches. Each changed caller has an unchanged old arm behind the chain switch; only one count path executes.
rows.native_abi: Original ECX=plane and EAX=count; reconstructed C++ uses a host reference and Raw handle and is not a binary ABI replacement.

rows.reason: Missing a production rocket-count callback and a typed all-platform traversal adapter for the owned rocket counters; current HUD hosts expose no 007C1DE0 count site.
The setter currently owns only pilot_skill_index; applying the body also needs validated dead-byte, weapon-director notification and kind-20h child-skill propagation bindings.
The native forwarding body requires the actual unit+38Ch skill-subobject vtable; the host scalar setter lacks that producer and the complete 009565A0 notification path.
The recorded teardown site lacks the captured movie-screen, input-context and cinematic-transition owner required by PrepareSoundTransition; its sound-only context is insufficient.

validation.build: scripts/build.ps1 passed Win32 Release and both existing CTests (reconstructed_math and tool_tests).
validation.call_graph: tools/call_graph.py and who 007c1db0 confirm one direct call to the reconstructed body from the changed units host and entry reachability.
validation.readiness_note: Readiness already text-classified 007C1DB0 as wired because of same-named host methods; executable call reachability is the improvement.
validation.runtime: Game not run; build and executable reachability evidence only.

left: Multi-rack attached-list ownership, torpedo/rocket count adapters, equipment-device mismatch cases and the skipped producer chains remain for later work.
